settings.hero_title: Made with Love, Worn with Joy
settings.story_text:
As parents, the search for good quality, comfortable clothing for our babies never really ends.

When I was expecting my twins, I was excited to start building their wardrobe. But that excitement quickly turned into
disappointment. The Indian kidswear market felt completely misaligned—either the options were overly expensive luxury pieces, or they were made with poor-quality fabrics, often polyester blends, yet still overpriced.

As a new mom, comfort and safety were non-negotiable. But I found myself struggling to find clothing made with soft, breathable, skin-friendly fabrics that were also stylish and reasonably priced.

Another gap became clear over time—while there were still
decent options for girls, boys’ clothing lacked variety, design, and
thoughtfulness.

And as every parent knows, babies outgrow their clothes in no time. Paying premium prices for something worn only a handful of times simply didn’t make sense.

That’s when the idea was born.

What started as a personal need soon became a purpose—to create a brand that truly understands parents.

A brand that offers thoughtfully designed, comfortable, and fashionable clothing made using skin-friendly fabrics, at prices that feel right.

That brand became The Tiny Bosses.
settings.val1_text: Every fabric is OEKO-TEX certified  -  free from harmful chemicals, kind to sensitive newborn skin.
settings.val2_text: Small-batch production means every piece gets the attention to detail your baby deserves.
settings.val3_text: Machine washable, colour-fast, and still beautiful after 50 washes. Real baby life approved.
settings.val4_text: Ethical suppliers who share our belief that beautiful things can also be responsible ones.
